676:t_5:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Words get through, but reason doesn't... You could say, in short, that communication with them is impossible.」

676:t_5:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Beings who can't come to understand each other, who can never be reconciled...」

676:t_5:18.en:
$$隼人$$
「They're beings that evolved in a different direction from us. The $$御使い$$s judged them to be $$バアル$$ and cast them as beings hostile to themselves.」

676:t_5:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Though in truth, they were beings carrying a factor called the Great Void, and in the end they were the enemy of everything alive.」

676:t_5:21.en:
$$隼人$$
「Put another way, the void... It's the force that seeks to vanish, itself.」

676:t_5:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「The opposite of the force that seeks to exist... So that's what causes the universe's great collapse once every 120 million years.」

676:t_5:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「If that's what gives birth to the $$バアル$$, then calling the Invaders that carry that factor $$バアル$$ isn't wrong, either.」

676:t_5:24.en:
$$シン$$
「You fought an enemy like that...」

676:t_5:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's nothing to be surprised about. In the end, we even wiped out the dimensional rift that spawns them.」

676:t_5:26.en:
$$シン$$
「How in the world did you do that!?」

676:t_5:27.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That was the result of his life drawing out the power of the $$ゲッター線$$.」

676:t_5:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ゼウス$$... So you've joined us, too.」

676:t_5:29.en:
$$シン$$
「So even a god has come over to our side...」

676:t_5:30.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I am no longer a god of $$オリュンポス$$. I am a single life living in this universe, and, like you, a warrior who protects such lives.」

676:t_5:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「I hear that until now, $$ゼウス$$ held back from interfering with us more than necessary, as was the mission of a higher-dimensional life form.」

676:t_5:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then why are you helping us now?」

676:t_5:33.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I judged that you, at least, would understand.」

676:t_5:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is it because humanity is standing at the entrance to evolution?」

676:t_5:35.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Exactly. Before long, by touching the truth, you will attain $$シンカ$$ and reach the stage called the sun's radiance.」

676:t_5:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The truth... Shinka... the sun's radiance...」

676:t_5:37.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Watching over the growth of the younger brothers who follow is the very duty of the elder brother, the higher-dimensional life forms.」

676:t_5:38.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「By rights, the $$御使い$$s, too, should be fulfilling that role.」

676:t_5:40.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Regrettably, little is known about them.」

676:t_5:41.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「What is certain is that they are the oldest race that exists in all the parallel universes.」

676:t_5:42.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$, who has the memories of the $$堕天翅$$s, called it a 120-million-year tie.」

676:t_5:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「At worst, they've existed since the birth of this universe...」

676:t_5:44.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We don't even know where they are, but first there's something we have to do.」

676:t_5:45.en:
$$シン$$
「The decisive battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$, whose nest is the galactic center, right?」

676:t_5:47.en:
$$號$$
「If they are the $$バアル$$, then by striking them down, the force that seeks to vanish will weaken, and the universe's great collapse can be prevented.」

676:t_5:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The next battle... Will it be the one that decides the fate of the universe?」

676:t_5:49.en:
$$刹那$$
「We have to win, no matter what... For the sake of all life in this universe, too...」

676:t_5:52.en:
$$アルト$$
「I just feel a little tired.」

676:t_5:53.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, you did a lot today, $$アルト$$.」

676:t_5:54.en:
$n
「Right. I was amazed you came through that $$時空震動$$ unharmed.」

676:t_5:55.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now you've earned the right to go by the nickname 'Spacequake Returnee', just like me.」

676:t_5:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Nobody wants a nickname like that...」

676:t_5:57.en:
$$カレン$$
「I guess it was the power of the $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s Fold Wave System after all?」

676:t_5:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
「In other words, the power of love?」

676:t_5:60.en:
$n
「This guy... he's got the look of someone who's shaken it all off...!」

676:t_5:61.en:
$$カレン$$
「Because a lot of things were settled in this battle.」

676:t_5:62.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you're tired, get some rest. At $$ランカ$$-chan's place.」

676:t_5:64.en:
$$アルト$$
(That feeling back then... It was a little different from when I used the Fold Wave System before...)

676:t_5:65.en:

$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$. He must have gone into this battle prepared from the start.」

676:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And by connecting hearts with you, he must have found some measure of satisfaction. After all, he produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z this way.」

676:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even $$ミカゲ$$, born from the hatred of the $$堕天翅$$s, had a moment when his heart was filled. I'll add these to the unit's stock.」

676:t_10:10.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I feel a little better.」

676:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome. But for something like this, please talk to $$アマタ$$ first.」

676:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, he's the one you love most.」

676:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
